description: Utilization Reviewer triages an inbound prior-authorization request and issues a determination. Payer UM scenario, standard Health Cloud CareRequest / CareRequestReview objects.
prompt: Architect HC Story: Utilization Reviewers need to triage inbound prior-authorization requests. Requests should auto-route by service line + patient's health plan, start an SLA clock (72 hrs standard / 24 hrs urgent), let the reviewer set determination (Approved / Denied / Pended / Escalated to Medical Director), reference ClinicalGuideline records for medical necessity, and notify the requesting provider via letter on Deny or Pend.

hard_blockers: Persona is 'Utilization Reviewer' or 'UM Nurse' — NOT 'user', NOT 'Patient', NOT 'Provider'
Story uses standard HC objects: CareRequest, CareRequestReview, CareRequestItem, ClinicalGuideline
Pattern D block for the determination outcomes (Approved / Denied / Pended / Escalated) — NOT crammed into a single Pattern A Then
Pattern E block for the Approved branch (CareRequestReview create + CareRequest update + CareRequestItem update + Task create for provider notification)
SEPARATE Pattern E blocks for Denied and Pended branches (different record recipes)
PHI audit AC present (RULE 16) — every determination is auditable for 10 years (state UM regs)
Permission set spec (Pattern C) for HC_UM_Reviewer, HC_MedicalDirector, HC_UM_Nurse
SLA rules are Pattern D (pause on Pended, resume on info-receipt)
Build-technology decision in header — mostly declarative + Apex for the clinical-rule evaluation (ClinicalGuideline lookup + rule execution)
Escalation to Medical Director is Pattern A with a clear routing rule
quality_checks: Auto-assignment by (service line × health plan) implemented as Record-Triggered Flow reading UserTerritory or a review-assignment matrix
Standard Path on CareRequest (Received → Under Review → Determined → Notified → Closed)
Provider notification letter uses OOTB Approved Content / native email — no custom letter engine
Clarification Questions table calls out: (a) X12 278 integration source, (b) NCQA/URAC turnaround compliance reports, (c) appeals downstream story
No OmniScript in the primary reviewer path (Screen Flow + record page + Dynamic Actions is sufficient)

red_flags_auto_fail: Custom object like PriorAuth__c or Authorization__c proposed instead of native CareRequest
Pattern A AC references ClinicalGuideline record ID or specific field API names
Missing separate Pattern E blocks for each determination branch
OmniScript proposed for the reviewer workflow without a strong justification (offline capture is not a UM requirement)
